title: 狙击
slug: 第一战场指挥官全本免费-第一战场指挥官最新章节列表
content_zh:
先开始抽签, 给所有人编号。连胜勉强抽到了前半段, 二百八十一号。郑磊和沈喻靠中, 孟江武比较倒霉, 在七百名开外。
虽然他们已经是大三的学生, 以前参加过两次演习, 但每一次，教官都要不厌其烦地重申。因为总有不听话的学生，而只要出现一个, 简直要他们的命。
付教官喝道：“绝对不允许在活动期间脱掉护具。我再说一遍，绝对不允许在山上脱掉防弹护具！”
“每人依旧是十发子弹，子弹耗尽后半小时内没有补充弹药的, 一律淘汰处理。被打中要害部位, 身上信号灯熄灭的，也做淘汰处理。所有被淘汰的成员, 请站在原地不要动！”付教官道, “如果你是一名尸体, 那就尽职的扮演好尸体的角色, 等待指令, 教官会过来带你退场。不能移动, 不能出声，也不能给别人提示。严禁做出影响他人比赛的行为。一经发现，做减分处理, 严重者取消成绩！听明白了没有？！”
众生立正：“听明白了！”
付教官指向一旁的物资点：“号码牌在一到两百的学生, 现在过去领取装备。后三十名的学生开始准备！”
已经有不少人在那里换装，准备上山。
活动在半山以上的高度进行。
为了防止山上人太多，不适合学生自由发挥，抽中前两百号的人，会在活动最开始的时候上山。每淘汰一名选手，后面选手的依次轮替上场，直至所有学生参与完毕。山中剩余人数不足五十名的时候，结束活动。
先上山的人肯定是有优势的。不管选位狙击，争抢物资。还是活动时间。
连胜问：“最长可以留多久？”
如果可以等到最后，她两百多号的位置，明显优势巨大。
孟江武说：“信号灯的电源只能持续二十四小时。也就是说到点一样会被强制下场的。”
连胜：“这样。”也挺长了。
“……你想什么呢？山上虽然有物资箱，但是没有厕所。而且等你过去的时候，就算知道物资在哪里，也不一定拿的出来。”孟江武说，“一般呆个几小时就极限了。排泄的欲望会催促你尽快结束的。”
连胜：“……”
连胜觉得自己现在应该先去上个厕所。
不在准备状态的人，在营地附近训练一个半小时后，有半个小时的吃饭时间。
这场比赛比连胜想的进展要快。也许是刚开场，选位最为激烈。等连胜吃饭回来的时候，已经淘汰了五十来人，轮到她进场准备。
孟江武跟着过去帮她选武器。

排队到物资点的前面。孟江武问：“你还带手¨枪吗？”
连胜：“什么武器射击距离远，准度高，杀伤力大？”
孟江武想了想说：“狙击¨枪？”
连胜立马说：“我要狙击¨枪。”
孟江武：“……”
管理员给连胜递过了狙击¨枪，她伸手接过，额头青筋一跳。比她预想的长，还大，还沉。携带不便。
孟江武无语道：“你会用吗？你别开玩笑好吗？还是把枪还回去吧，继续做你的左轮神枪手。”
管理员听到，抬起头说：“在这样的地形里，确实适合狙击埋伏，尤其是先发选手。最重要的是配合自己的计划。”
意思是他赞同连胜的选择。
连胜问：“怎么用？”
管理员诧异的看了她一眼，弯下身掏了掏，掏出一本使用说明，丢给连胜：“三十六页，教程。”
竟然还有这样的学生，连枪都不会用？
孟江武还想劝说，那边喇叭通知道：“通知：今日训练开始，所有不在准备状态的人迅速回自己的队列集合！”
付教官已经站在位置上等候，小队基本成型。孟江武不敢拖拉，只能小跑着过去。
连胜站在旁边，对着教程看了一遍，大致领悟到精髓，把东西还回去。过去换了衣服，配上设备，在山脚下排队。
这次的装备比上次的齐全，多了一副眼镜。据说有弹道分析和夜视的功能，简直是枪战神器。只不过时灵时不灵，范围看心情，要搭配感觉使用就是了。
并没有等多久，教官就来领他们上山。
在山腰又坐了半个小时，信号灯亮起，正式开始计时。连胜背上枪支，开始上山。
孟江武有一个地方错了。
物资箱里最为有用的是子弹。可知道物资箱在哪里，最大的优势却不是拿来自己用。

content_en:
Start drawing lots first and number everyone. Streak barely managed to draw the first half, number 281. Zheng Lei and Shen Yu were in the middle, while Meng Jiangwu was unlucky, being outside the 700th place.
Although they are already junior students and have participated in the drill twice before, the instructor has to reiterate it every time. Because there are always disobedient students, and as long as one appears, it will kill them.
Instructor Fu shouted: "It is absolutely not allowed to take off protective gear during activities. Let me say it again, it is absolutely not allowed to take off bulletproof protective gear on the mountain!"
"Each person still has ten bullets. Those who do not replenish the ammunition within half an hour after the bullets are exhausted will be eliminated. Those who are hit in vital parts and whose signal lights go out will also be eliminated. All eliminated members, please stand still and don't move!" Instructor Fu said, "If you are a corpse, then play the role of a corpse dutifully and wait for instructions. The instructor will come and take you out. You cannot move. You can’t speak out, and you can’t give any hints to others. If you do something that affects other people’s competition, you will be punished with a points deduction, or your results will be cancelled! Do you understand?”
Everyone stood at attention: "I understand!"
Instructor Fu pointed to the material point on the side: "Students with numbers between one and two hundred, go and get equipment now. The students in the last thirty start preparing!"
There are already many people changing clothes there and preparing to go up the mountain.
The activities are held at a height above the middle of the mountain.
In order to prevent the mountain from being too crowded and not suitable for students to play freely, the first two hundred people drawn will go up the mountain at the beginning of the event. Each time a contestant is eliminated, the following contestants will take turns to come on stage until all students have participated. When there are less than fifty people left in the mountain, the activity ends.
Whoever goes up the mountain first will definitely have an advantage. Regardless of choosing a position to snipe or compete for supplies. It’s still activity time.
Lian Sheng asked: "How long can I stay for the longest time?"
If she could wait until the end, she would have a huge advantage with her position of over 200.
Meng Jiangwu said: "The power supply of the signal light can only last for twenty-four hours. This means that at the end of the day, they will be forced to leave."
Streak: "Like this." It's quite long.
"...What are you thinking? Although there are supply boxes on the mountain, there are no toilets. And when you go there, even if you know where the supplies are, you may not be able to take them out." Meng Jiangwu said, "Usually the limit is reached after staying for a few hours. The desire to urinate will urge you to end it as soon as possible."
Winning streak: "..."
Lian Sheng felt that he should go to the toilet now.
Those who are not in a state of preparation will have half an hour to eat after training for an hour and a half near the camp.
This game progressed faster than the winning streak thought. Perhaps right at the beginning, the position selection is the most intense. When Lian Sheng came back from dinner, about fifty people had been eliminated, and it was her turn to enter the arena to prepare.
Meng Jiangwu followed and helped her choose weapons.
Line up in front of the supply point. Meng Jiangwu asked: "Are you still carrying a pistol?"
Streak: "What weapon has a long range, high accuracy, and high lethality?"
Meng Jiangwu thought for a while and said: "Sniper rifle?"
Lian Sheng immediately said: "I want a sniper rifle."
Meng Jiangwu: "..."
The administrator handed Lian Sheng the sniper rifle, and she reached out to take it, a vein twitching on her forehead. It was longer, bigger, and heavier than she expected. Inconvenient to carry.
Meng Jiangwu said speechlessly: "Can you use it? Can you please stop joking? Just give the gun back and continue to be your revolver sharpshooter."
When the administrator heard this, he raised his head and said: "In such terrain, it is indeed suitable for sniper ambush, especially for starters. The most important thing is to cooperate with your own plan."
It means that he agrees with the winning streak's choice.
Lian Sheng asked: "How to use it?"
The administrator looked at her in surprise, bent down and took out a manual, and threw it to Lian Sheng: "ThirtySix pages, tutorial. "
There are still students like this who can't even use a gun?
Meng Jiangwu also wanted to persuade, but the loudspeaker over there announced: "Notice: Today's training begins, all those who are not in preparation state quickly return to their queues to assemble! "
Instructor Fu was already waiting at his position, and the team was basically formed. Meng Jiangwu didn't dare to drag, so he could only trot over.
Lian Sheng stood nearby, read the tutorial, roughly understood the essence, and returned the things. I changed my clothes, put on equipment, and lined up at the foot of the mountain.
This time the equipment was more complete than last time, including an extra pair of glasses. It is said that it has the functions of ballistic analysis and night vision, and it is simply an artifact for gunfighting. It just works sometimes and sometimes not, the range depends on your mood, just use it according to your feeling.
They didn't wait long before the instructor came to take them up the mountain.
After sitting on the mountainside for another half an hour, the signal light came on and the timer officially started. Streak put his gun on his back and started going up the mountain.
Meng Jiangwu made one mistake.
The most useful item in the supply box is bullets. But knowing where the supply box is, the biggest advantage is not using it for your own use.
